list.title: Modules
list.description: Modules installed on this gateway, and whether they are set up and running.

empty.title: No modules installed
empty.message: Install a module from a configured repository to get started.

noMatch.title: No module matches
noMatch.message: No installed module matches the current search and filter.

list.loadedWithErrors: Loaded with errors — click for details
list.updateHint: The installed module changed (installed: {{version}} / {{channel}}, set up from: {{deployedVersion}} / {{deployedChannel}}). Edit the setup to apply the change.
list.confirmDelete: Remove the setup(s) of {{count}} module(s)? Data stored in volumes will be removed.
list.moduleLoadedWithErrors: The module was loaded with errors

manage.title: Catalog
manage.description: Modules offered by the configured repositories. Collect what you want to change, then review and apply it in one go.
manage.pendingRequest: A change request is pending on the gateway. It stays there until it is applied or discarded — a repository refresh discards it too.

empty.title: No modules found
empty.message: Nothing matches the current filter. If the catalog is empty altogether, refresh the repositories to fetch the latest module list.

manage.switchHint: Switch to the selected repository and channel

info.loadedWithErrors: The module was loaded with errors.

deployment.title: Setup
deployment.none: This module is not set up yet.
deployment.drift: installed {{version}} — edit the setup to apply

info.endpointsHint: Web interfaces this module exposes through the gateway. An alias gives one a shorter path of your own.
info.auxDeploymentsHint: Extra containers this module spawned at runtime. Read-only — modules manage them themselves.
info.confirmDelete: Remove the setup of {{name}}? Data stored in volumes will be removed.

configs.title: Configuration
configs.none: This module declares no configuration values.
configs.hintDeployed: The module declares these values; the setup answers some of them. Anything it does not answer keeps the module default.
configs.hintNotDeployed: The module declares these values. Setting it up is where they get answered; until then the module defaults apply.

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.description: Sources the gateway fetches installable modules from. A higher priority wins when the same module is offered more than once.

empty.title: No repositories configured
empty.message: Without a repository the catalog stays empty. Add a GitHub repository to make modules installable.

repositories.builtInHint: Part of the core installation and cannot be removed
repositories.confirmDelete: Delete repository '{{source}}'? Its modules can no longer be installed or updated.
repositories.notRemovable: This repository is part of the core installation and cannot be removed.

globalConfigs.title: Global configs
globalConfigs.description: Values that several modules can reference instead of each setting them separately.

empty.title: No global configs defined
empty.message: A global config holds one value centrally. In a module's setup form, switch a field to “Global config” to point at it instead of typing the value again.

globalConfigs.confirmDelete: Delete global config '{{name}}'? Modules referencing it will lose the value.

addRepositoryDialog.title: Add repository
addRepositoryDialog.hint: Passed verbatim to the repository type handler
addRepositoryDialog.definitionRequired: Enter the source definition of the repository to add

changeRequestDialog.title: Review module changes
changeRequestDialog.created: Created {{date}}. The request stays pending on the gateway until it is applied or discarded; refreshing the repositories also discards it.
changeRequestDialog.empty: Nothing to do — all requested modules are already installed in the requested variant and version.
changeRequestDialog.removeHint: A module can only be removed while it is not set up. Remove its setup on the Modules page first.

globalConfigDialog.name: Name
globalConfigDialog.editHint: Modules referencing this config use the value as declared by their module config — changing the data type can break them.
globalConfigDialog.valuesHintBool: One value per line (true or false)

refreshReposDialog.title: Refresh repositories
refreshReposDialog.warning: Refreshing discards the pending change request.
refreshReposDialog.lead: Select the repositories to fetch the latest module list from.
